components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Raises a ward on the altar: a vampire who has not been invited cannot stay inside it. Whoever sneaks on the centre owns it (the caster if nobody stands there).
It turns away every kind of vampire, werewolves not. Only a witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can work it, and a vampire cannot own one. It falls if its owner dies or becomes a vampire.
